strict_definitions.falsification: A bounded tranche outcome that demonstrates current path inconsistency, contradiction, or baseline-indistinguishability under declared criteria and retires or reroutes that path.
strict_definitions.discriminator: A bounded output that yields a unique differentiator versus baseline or competing pathway with explicit comparison criteria.
strict_definitions.state_conversion: A measurable transition in blocker class/row state or parity state with explicit evidence pointer.

non_claim_boundary: Repository-local discovery-engine transition packet only; no scientific adequacy claim.
